metadata.description: Classification results for Ontario Social Benefits Tribunal (ONSBT) and Ontario WSIB Internal Review (ONWSIB) decisions

visualizationSuggestions.title: Ontario Tribunals: Clear Outcome Rates
visualizationSuggestions.description: Compare WSIAT (3.4%), ONSBT (56.4%), and ONWSIB (2.8%) clear outcome rates

visualizationSuggestions.title: ONSBT Outcome Distribution (14,298 decisions)
visualizationSuggestions.description: Breakdown showing 55.8% allowed, 34.3% unclear, 9.2% other, 0.6% denied

visualizationSuggestions.title: Win Rate Comparison: WSIAT vs ONSBT vs ONWSIB
visualizationSuggestions.description: Worker success rates: WSIAT 89.1%, ONSBT 98.9%, ONWSIB 83.3%

visualizationSuggestions.title: ONWSIB Internal Review Outcomes (431 decisions)
visualizationSuggestions.description: 95.8% unclear outcomes highlights lack of explicit outcome language in internal reviews

keyFindings: ONSBT has 16x higher clear outcome rate than WSIAT (56.4% vs 3.4%)
ONSBT shows 98.9% worker success rate from clear outcomes - highest among Ontario tribunals
ONWSIB internal reviews have 95.8% unclear outcomes - even worse than WSIAT
Social benefits eligibility determinations are more explicit than workplace injury decisions
Only 88 denials out of 14,298 ONSBT decisions (0.6%) - extremely low denial rate
